mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) consistently correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as it reduces the cost of capital and increases equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.3 percentage points over three months signals labor market deterioration, which typically precedes negative equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1100 and real sales (RSAFS) exceed 450000, robust consumer demand supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1100 and RSAFS > 450000.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 indicates weakening supply capacity, which often leads to negative equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4.5%, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE) consistently correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as it reflects a strong labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate profits.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle economic expansions, strong housing starts (HOUST) above 1100 indicate robust consumer demand that supports corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances during late-cycle expansions when HOUST > 1100.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 and GDP (GDPC1) declines below 17000, it indicates a contraction in supply capacity and economic output, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100 and GDPC1 < 17000.
